settlement_source: FOOTBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf: governing league (NFL) first, then ESPN, Fox Sports, NFL.com, official broadcaster; league box score / play-by-play.
settlement_variable: Player touchdowns scored (>=1; floor_strike 0.5) in the specified NFL game, regulation + overtime, per official box score/play-by-play. Offensive fake punt/FG touchdowns not counted as special-teams TD.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Sample close/expiration is days after kickoff (e.g. game Nov 2, close 2026-11-05T01:15Z); latest expiration 15 days after game; last trading time = expiration time per PDF; settlement_timer 60s; can_close_early=1.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Player active but never takes a snap: settles to fair market price before game start (not No). Once a snap is taken (even nullified by penalty) settles on TDs. Postponement/rescheduling handling: unknown (rules reference 'originally scheduled' game). Kalshi Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title '1+ touchdowns' omits that no-snap players settle at fair price rather than No.
Title omits fake-kick offensive TD exclusion from special-teams TDs.
Rules reference game 'originally scheduled' date; market expiration is days later.
toxicity_flags: in-game: TD already scored is public before market closes; stale quotes adverse-selected
pre-game inactive/snap news; fair-price settlement regime is discretionary
injury/lineup info asymmetry on player props
market may remain tradable after game end until close
594 open markets, thin books per player
notes: Some sample rows are for already-played games (stale open rows) - check close_time before using.
